evidence: Cic. Rosc. Am. 63: esse aliquem hūmānā speciē et figūrā (Lewis & Short s.v. hūmānus)
terms.comment: A description of ours: robōtum with the ablative of description, as Cicero says of a man that he has human form. No reference work has a word for an android; the Greek android (ἀνδροειδής, “man-like”) has not been found in Latin.

phrases.latin: Huic robōtō caput est et bracchia, ut hominī.
phrases.english: This robot has a head and arms, like a person.

sources: Lewis & Short: humanus · Lewis & Short: species
